gloss: infant home; nursery for abandoned or orphaned infants

definitions.gloss: infant home; nursery for abandoned or orphaned infants
definitions.explanation: A residential facility that cares for infants and toddlers (typically under age 2 or 3) who cannot be raised by their parents due to neglect, abuse, parental illness, or other circumstances. A type of child welfare institution in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{乳児院|にゅうじいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{預|あず}けられた→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧。
examples.english: The baby was placed in an infant home.

examples.japanese: {乳児院|にゅうじいん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I volunteer at an infant home.

examples.japanese: {乳児院|にゅうじいん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}った→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦その{後|ご}→その後：08501_sonogo⟧⟦{養子|ようし}→養子：14626_youshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}される→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{児童養護施設|じどうようごしせつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}る→移る：01232_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: Many children raised in infant homes are later adopted or transferred to children's welfare facilities.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{乳児|にゅうじ}→乳児：11414_nyuuji⟧ (infant, baby) and {院|いん} (institution). These are specifically for very young children, typically from birth to around age 2. After that age, children move to {児童養護施設|じどうようごしせつ} (children's homes) if they cannot return to their families.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乳児院|にゅうじいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{預|あず}ける→預ける：01819_azukeru⟧: to place (a child) in an infant home
- {乳児院|にゅうじいん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{育|そだ}つ→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧: to grow up in an infant home
- {乳児院|にゅうじいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧: infant home staff

- {児童養護施設|じどうようごしせつ}: children's welfare facility — for older children (roughly ages 2-18)
- {養子縁組|ようしえんぐみ}: adoption — the legal process of adopting a child

- {孤児院|こじいん}: orphanage — an older, more general term
